bundle.shortDescription: Local-first password manager and identity vault
bundle.longDescription: Persona is a local-first password manager and digital identity vault. It stores credentials, SSH keys, passkeys and identity documents in a single database encrypted at rest (Argon2id verification, PBKDF2 key wrapping, per-item keys). Highlights: cross-identity quick search, TOTP, Watchtower health scans, item change history, encrypted attachments, auto-lock with re-authentication for sensitive operations, and an embedded SSH agent with per-request desktop approval.
